		var:tv_great_engineer_char ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_event_engineer }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_event_site }
	}

	option = {
		name = tv_engineering_department.7206.a
		if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_construction_event_7206_eligible_trigger = yes }
			add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = -0.40 }
		}
	}
}
